map.功率 dB 为什么乘 10？: Why is power dB multiplied by 10?
map.分贝基于功率比的对数，功率与幅度平方对应，故系数 10（幅度则 20）。: Decibels are the logarithm of a power ratio, and power corresponds to amplitude squared, hence the coefficient 10 (20 for amplitude).
map.负值怎么理解？: How to read a negative value?
map.负 dB 表示 p1 小于 p2，即衰减或损耗。: A negative dB means p1 is smaller than p2, i.e. attenuation or loss.
